title: First state of emergency of the pandemic
summary: The president declared a state of emergency on 18 March 2020, the first under the 1976 constitution, and parliament renewed it twice before it lapsed on 2 May; it was declared again in November. Movement, assembly and most economic activity were restricted by decree for six weeks.
